title: Run an off-course totalizator only under the TAB's exclusive licence
what: During the exclusivity period, only the TAB or its subsidiary may be licensed to conduct an off-course totalizator.

sources.title: Totalizator Act 1997 (NSW)
sources.quote: 14 TAB entitled to exclusive off-course totalizator licence (1) TAB or a wholly owned subsidiary of TAB is entitled to be granted a licence (the TAB off-course licence) to conduct an off-course totalizator during the exclusivity period in respect of betting on the following events and contingencies— (a) events and contingencies scheduled to be held at a race meeting on any racecourse within or outside Australia (being horse racing, harness racing or greyhound racing events or contingencies), (b) any declared betting event (within the meaning of the Betting and Racing Act 1998). assessment.summary: Only the TAB may hold the off-course totalizator licence during the exclusivity period. A statutory exclusive right to pool betting off course.

marks.reason: No other person may be licensed to run an off-course totalizator during the exclusivity period.
Shelters the TAB's pool betting from rival totalizators, though fixed-odds bookmakers compete.

assessment.confidence_note: The exclusivity is explicit; its end date depends on a gazetted operative date, not quoted here.
